q: Who is known as the pioneer of intelligence testing?
Alfred Binet created the first practical intelligence test.
Kohlberg's theory deals with which type of development?

Order: physiological, safety, belonging, esteem, self-actualisation.
Pavlov is associated with which theory?
Pavlov's dog experiments explain classical conditioning.
Skinner is associated with which theory?
Formative assessment monitors learning while it is happening.
Educating all children together, whatever their abilities
Inclusive education brings all learners into the same classroom with support.
